meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

howto.what: 使用 Cirq 框架构建、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模、电路优化，并可在 Google 等硬件后端上运行。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Cirq 编程、面向 Google Quantum AI 硬件、设计考虑噪声的电路或做量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 构建一个两比特电路，加测量并模拟1000次
say.note: 输出电路与直方图结果

say.text: 给电路加入退极化噪声，比较有无噪声的模拟结果
say.note: 使用密度矩阵模拟器运行

say.text: 把参数化电路用参数扫描跑一遍，输出各角度结果
say.note: 使用 cirq.Linspace 扫描参数

howto.what_en: Uses Cirq to build, simulate, and run quantum circuits, including parameter sweeps, noise modeling, circuit optimization, and execution on Google and other hardware backends.

say_en.text: Build a two-qubit circuit with Cirq, add measurement, and simulate 1000 times
